summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an At-the-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Spartan Capital Securities, LLC as sales agent. The agreement allows the company to sell up to $300 million of Class A common stock from time to time via an ATM offering under Rule 415, pursuant to its effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3. Shares will be sold at market prices, with the company setting parameters including minimum price and daily volume limits. No premium, fixed price, or board recommendation is stated. This equity issuance is intended to raise capital, which falls under capital returns as a financing event, though no direct return to shareholders is specified. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown, but given the scale, it is classified as a capital return with medium confidence. What to watch: dilution impact and market reception. No risk-arb angle.
